body:
# The Essentials

**A modpack with all the essential mods**

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f286a99764b7231c95b0b59c386067bc1bdd7e62.png)

The Essentials is a carefully curated modpack that fills in the gaps vanilla Minecraft leaves behind. No overhauls, no massive content additions, just the mods every player deserves to have. Better performance, smoother visuals, smarter UI, and a world that feels more alive.

## Performance
The Essentials runs better than vanilla out of the box. Sodium, Iris, C2ME, FerriteCore, Dynamic FPS and EntityCulling work together to give you the smoothest possible experience without sacrificing anything.

## Immersion
The world around you feels alive. Particle Rain, Presence Footsteps, Sound Physics Remastered, LambDynamicLights and Ripple make every moment more satisfying, from the sound of your footsteps to particles that actually react to your movement.

## Quality of Life
Everything just works better. Jade tells you what you're looking at, Xaero's Minimap keeps you oriented, Vein Miner saves your wrists, and dozens of small improvements make the experience feel polished and complete.

## Visual Polish
Not Enough Animations, Wavey Capes, Entity Model Features, Continuity and Button Animations bring subtle life to everything on screen without making the game feel like a different game.

## The Details
- Fabric based
- Fully configured out of the box
- Lightweight and performance friendly
- No unnecessary bloat

This is Minecraft the way it was always meant to be played.
